title: A backrow card becomes a Unit only with Animated and stats
notes: R2280000: a Field Spell, Trap or Field Trap becomes a Unit only with Animated and stats (printed, fused, statsOverride or X stats); R657's 0/1 fallback and its two constants are gone, the animate verb needs Animated, and a Nerf's or Buff's stats change reaches a Unit or a card with stats. R2280001: a face-up backrow card that first has both animates at the state check. Rod of Ages and Twice Forward One Step Backwards lose their printed stats; Rod lends its Equip play in its backrow zone too (R1869000).

player.title: Animated cards need stats to become Units
balance: Rod of Ages has no stats, down from 1/1 (Radiant 2/2).
Twice Forward One Step Backwards has no stats, down from 0/1 (Radiant 0/2).
changes: A Field Spell, Trap or Field Trap becomes a Unit only when it has both Animated and stats. One with no stats stays in your backrow.
A face-up card in your backrow that gains stats and Animated, for instance from a Fuse, becomes a Unit right away if a unit zone is open.
A Buff or a Nerf changes the stats of a card in the backrow only when it has stats.
Rod of Ages stays in your backrow. The first Unit you play onto it there fuses in, and Rod becomes a Flying Unit with that Unit's stats.
Twice Forward One Step Backwards becomes a Unit only once it fuses a copy of a Unit. Until then it stays face-up in your backrow and keeps counting.
